task:
Add a logging sidecar container to an existing Deployment.

Context: A Deployment named 'cleaner' exists in namespace 'mercury'. It has a main container that writes logs to /var/log/cleaner.log via a shared volume named 'logs'.

Setup (if Deployment does not exist, create it):
  kubectl create ns mercury
  kubectl create deploy cleaner --image=busybox:1.35 -n mercury -- /bin/sh -c 'i=0; while true; do echo "$(date): cleaning item $i" >> /var/log/cleaner.log; i=$((i+1)); sleep 2; done'
  # Then add volume 'logs' (emptyDir) to the deployment and mount at /var/log

Task: Add a sidecar container to the 'cleaner' Deployment:
  - Container name: logger-con
  - Image: busybox:1.35
  - Command: ['/bin/sh', '-c', 'tail -n+1 -f /var/log/cleaner.log']
  - Mount the existing volume 'logs' at /var/log

Save the updated Deployment YAML to /opt/course/16/cleaner-new.yaml

Verify:
  kubectl get deploy cleaner -n mercury -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers}' | python3 -m json.tool | grep name
  kubectl logs -n mercury -l app=cleaner -c logger-con
hints: kubectl get deploy cleaner -n mercury -o yaml > /opt/course/16/cleaner-new.yaml
Add logger-con container to spec.template.spec.containers[] array
Reuse the existing volume 'logs' — add volumeMounts to the new container
detailed_hints: Edit YAML to add under spec.template.spec.containers:
The volume 'logs' must be declared in spec.template.spec.volumes too
setup: kubectl create deploy cleaner --image=busybox:1.35 -n mercury -- /bin/sh -c 'i=0; while true; do echo "$(date): cleaning item $i" >> /var/log/cleaner.log; i=$((i+1)); sleep 2; done' 2>/dev/null || true

kubectl patch deploy cleaner -n mercury --type=json -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/volumes","value":[{"name":"logs","emptyDir":{}}]},{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/volumeMounts","value":[{"name":"logs","mountPath":"/var/log"}]}]' 2>/dev/null || true
